The diagram shows a motor and a light-dependent resistor (LDR) connected in a circuit.

Which change decreases the current in the motor so that it turns more slowly?
A
connecting a resistor in parallel with the LDR
B
connecting a resistor in series with the LDR
C
exchanging the positions of the motor and the LDR in the circuit
D
increasing the brightness of the light falling on the LDR
